status: provisional, decided in 12.3 on 2026-09-04 and to be confirmed against the 13.1 data retention decision
rationale: Thirty days covers an incident investigation window and is the free tier for the _Default bucket; the counts that matter beyond it live in the log-based metrics, which Cloud Monitoring keeps as time series. Nothing needs to outlive the bucket today, so there is no sink; a sink would be declared here and applied when one is needed.
